I have been farming this land for many years, and maize is what feeds my family, so I will use fertilizer on this plot to get a good harvest. I was able to get some subsidized fertilizer through FISP, and I will put it on my maize since that is my most important crop. I will also plant hybrid seed because it gives better yields when you use fertilizer. We do not use irrigation here in Lilongwe—we wait for the rains—and I do not see the need for chemicals to kill pests on maize. My family will do most of the work, about twenty days across the season, but I may hire a few young men to help with ridging when the soil is heavy.
